description:
Music to Sleep Through the Night | Bansuri | 3 Hours of Deep Rest

It's not always falling asleep that's hard — it's staying asleep. Waking at 3am, a restless mind, a night that never feels deep enough.

This soft Indian bamboo flute (bansuri) music is made to carry you gently through the whole night — slow, low, and continuous, with nothing to jolt you awake.

Enjoy 3 hours of breathy, drowsy bansuri blended with a warm tanpura drone and soft ambient texture — no percussion, no build-ups, no interruptions. Just an even, calming current to sleep straight through.

Perfect for sleeping through the night, insomnia and 3am waking, deep rest, meditation before sleep, and quiet nighttime calm.

🎵 ABOUT THIS MUSIC
Instrument: Bansuri (Indian bamboo flute) & Tanpura Drone
Raga: Raga Bageshri — soft late-night character
Style: Indian ambient sleep / deep-rest instrumental
Mood: Slow, low, drowsy, continuous, calming
Atmosphere: Sleep through the night, deep rest, nighttime stillness
Duration: 3 Hours

🎧 HOW TO USE
Play this as you get into bed. Keep the volume low, set your phone aside, and let the soft bansuri hold the whole night. For the most immersive experience, use headphones for a while, or play quietly through a speaker.
